::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 13th 1875  
**From:** Elderfield,  Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection C0171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Miss Medhurst](people/person_988.qmd)
Thanks for your verses which no doubt will please many, though I have never set foot in Brighton and so have no knowledge of the place.[^1] I never thanked you for the good news of [Mrs Mercier](people/person_990.qmd) who I hope is quite well again

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: These verses do not seem to have been published in *MP*.
